notes.title: Update - July 10 2025
notes.notes:
Added:
The Western Dream side story has been completed and is ready to play (Still needs testing)

Note: You need to have unlocked the relevant dream in the prologue to access it.
Changes:
Some minor bugs were fixed

Language switching issue was resolved

Some voice lines were changed and volume-related issues were fixed

Settings menu was reorganized to be more user-friendly

Save system was updated
